name: Employee Wise APC
query:
WITH invoice_data AS (
    SELECT
        a.`name` AS `invoice_name`,
        DATE_ADD(
            DATE(a.`posting_date`),
            INTERVAL CASE
                WHEN TIME(a.`posting_time`) >= CONCAT(LPAD(COALESCE(rs.`hours`, 0), 2, '0'), ':00:00')
                    THEN 0
                ELSE -1
            END DAY
        ) AS `date`,
        a.`no_of_pax` AS `no_of_pax`,
        a.`grand_total` AS `sales_amount`
    FROM `tabPOS Invoice` a
    LEFT JOIN `tabURY Report Settings` rs ON rs.`branch` = %(branch)s
    WHERE
        a.`branch` = %(branch)s
        AND a.`restaurant_table` != ""
        AND a.`order_type` != "Take Away"
        AND a.`status` IN ("Consolidated", "Paid")
        AND a.`docstatus` = 1
        AND a.`no_of_pax` > 0
)
SELECT
    i.`date` AS "Date",
    i.`invoice_name` AS "Invoice Name",
    ROUND(i.`sales_amount`, 2) AS "Sales Amount",
    i.`no_of_pax` AS "No of Pax",
    ROUND(i.`sales_amount` / NULLIF(i.`no_of_pax`, 0), 2) AS "APC"
FROM invoice_data i
ORDER BY i.`date` DESC, i.`invoice_name`;
